about: PauseMotion — one button that pauses every loop on the page, and plays them again: spinners, skeletons, a busy button's turn, the tachometer, and any motion of the page's own marked `data-motion-class

playLabel.about: The action while it is paused.

reducedReason.default: "Animations are off in your device settings."
reducedReason.about: Said beside it, and read as its description, when the device has motion off and the control has nothing to do.

remember.about: Keep the choice for the next page (localStorage). Default true.

omit.PauseMotion.Motion: runtime state: running or paused is the person's choice (remembered), reduced comes from the device setting
